records.displaySummary: Provides a shared overview for explicit constructions and ensemble questions while retaining their different deliverables. N=1 is specified where supported; the supersymmetry count of other F-term descriptions is left unstated.

Geometry, protected amplitudes and brane/CFT data connect several physical targets. Dimensions, regimes and evidential status remain distinct; shared geometry, modularity or partition-function language does not establish question identity.

Constructions, obstructions, unstable extrema, statistical metastability and consistency tests span different dimensions and supersymmetries. Shared formal tools can connect sources with different physical targets.

A discovery family spanning different systems, dimensions and mechanisms. Construction, formulation, scalar stability, effective-theory control, spectra and cosmological evolution are separate targets.

Geometric construction, mirror and period calculations, degeneration theory, internal metrics and their physical applications form connected targets. Related questions retain their distinct systems, mechanisms and approximations.
